name: reopen-reason-audit
title: Persist the gated PLAN->INIT reopen reason into the phase_transition audit event and correct two overstated comments
description:
A codex host-B review of B-8b69 found that the gated PLAN->INIT reopen validates its required `reason` (>= REOPEN_REASON_MIN chars, transition-orchestrator.ts) but never persists it, so the code comments and docs/requirements/decisions/plan-init-reopen.md claim the reopen is 'gated and auditable' when only the gating half is durable. Persist the reason (with a transitionType marker) into the append-only phase_transition process event so the audit claim is mechanically true.

The same review flagged two overstated comments: the REOPEN checklist-reset atomicity is concurrency-atomic (mkdir persist-claim) rather than crash-transactional, so 'land together or not at all' overstates it; and the dev_start `git worktree prune --expire now` clears unrelated already-missing registrations while being unable to prune live siblings.

All three are LOW severity cleanup, not a correctness fix. A reference implementation already exists as 3 commits on branch claude/confident-cori-2cb5dc (05385c9, de46617, 48b82c0): TDD'd (assertion RED before, GREEN after) and independently audited by an implementation-reviewer subagent that returned pass. This story exists to give that work a lifecycle home so it reaches main through the DONE gate chain, which is also the only path that performs the mandatory CLI version bump (bumpVersionOnDoneMerge; there is no manual version command).
